description: This file defines the OrganizationUserService class which manages organization user operations such as reading, creating, updating, and deleting organization users, including interactions with related entities like organizations, roles, workspaces, and users.

classes.name: OrganizationUserService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage organization users, including CRUD operations and related entity interactions.

methods.name: validateOrganizationUserStatus
methods.description: Validates if the provided organization user status is valid according to OrganizationUserStatus enum.

methods.name: readOrganizationUserByOrganizationIdUserId
methods.description: Retrieves organization user details by organization ID and user ID.

methods.name: readOrganizationUserByWorkspaceIdUserId
methods.description: Retrieves organization user details via workspace ID and user ID.

methods.name: readOrganizationUserByOrganizationId
methods.description: Retrieves all organization users for a given organization ID, including last login info and role count.

methods.name: readOrganizationUserByOrganizationIdRoleId
methods.description: Retrieves organization users filtered by organization ID and role ID.

methods.name: readOrganizationUserByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves all organization roles associated with a user, including organization details.

methods.name: readOrgUsersCountByOrgId
methods.description: Counts the number of users in an organization.

methods.name: createNewOrganizationUser
methods.description: Creates a new OrganizationUser entity instance.

methods.name: saveOrganizationUser
methods.description: Saves an OrganizationUser entity to the database.

methods.name: createOrganizationUser
methods.description: Creates a new organization user with transaction management.

methods.name: createOrganization
methods.description: Creates a new organization and assigns an owner user within a transaction.

methods.name: updateOrganizationUser
methods.description: Updates an existing organization user within a transaction.

methods.name: deleteOrganizationUser
methods.description: Deletes an organization user and related workspace user entries.
